description: This stacked vertical bar chart illustrates the number of experts assigned across 24 distinct layers. The horizontal categories axis, labeled "Layer," displays discrete numerical categories ordered sequentially from 1 to 24. The vertical value axis, labeled "Number of Experts," utilizes a linear scale ranging from 0 to 10, with numeric tick labels and corresponding horizontal grid lines positioned at intervals of 2. Each layer is represented by a stacked bar divided into three vertically arranged, color-coded components, defined by a top-center legend. The bottom segment of every bar represents "G0" and is colored blue, the middle segment represents "G1" in green, and the top segment represents "G2" in yellow. Across all 24 layers, the blue G0 component maintains a consistent value of 1. The green G1 and yellow G2 components fluctuate in size, causing the overall height of the stacked bars to vary across the chart. The tallest bar is located at Layer 1, reaching a total height of 9 (comprising a value of 1 for G0, 4 for G1, and 4 for G2). The shortest bars have a total height of 3 and appear at Layers 7, 11 through 15, 23, and 24, where each of the three components typically contributes a value of 1 to the total stack. The bars are sorted in ascending numerical order by their layer number, and no specific bars are visually emphasized with shading, bold outlines, or additional annotations.
